objective: Exploratory census with a frozen contract. Random 3-variable knots on 3, 4, 5 and 6 values: which are resolved by a direct case, the fibre-distance construction, the diagonal derivation, or a small system without cross-position identification. Random 4-variable knots on 2 and 3 values. Group-action knots. Random shadow products: no failure and the dominating law's constrained sets in every sampled system. A bounded search for 3-variable knots on 4 and 5 values with no failure.
status: Refuted on L4, L5 and L6; L1-L3 hold (DIAGONAL-LEMMA-20261021-001A-E001, exploratory; the independent check rebuilt every recorded witness and recount; its first version treated a shadow with no recorded inner-factor failure as a disagreement and was corrected to compare with the record). Every non-rectangular random knot was resolved: 3-variable knots on 3-6 values (160 with no direct case, all by systems without cross-position identification, 154 also by the diagonal derivation) and 4-variable knots on 2-3 values (50 with no direct case). Every shadow product had its difference law's constrained sets and no failure in all 9000 sampled systems, but one inner factor (x+y+z=0 over Z3 with two extra tuples) showed no failure either, against L5's control clause. The dihedral action on a square's corners showed no failure in the positional search (L4). Of 49 knots on 4 and 5 values lifted from x+y+z=0 over Z3, 48 showed no failure within budget (L6); they are candidates for ticket B.
title: Census: where the diagonal lemma holds
